policy.b2_inputs: source PDF, page, selected text/occurrence, replacement; optional explicit substitute font approval. No oracle geometry or source-name special cases.
policy.approvals: Geometry is proposed by B2 then explicitly accepted. Ambiguity must be exposed; no automatic expansion after failure.
policy.fairness: Fixed oracle mask and maximum movement envelope used for all arms; source font reuse and same explicit substitute allowed. B1 remains the unmodified PR86 two-paragraph engine.
policy.protected: All content outside oracle paragraphs, including non-text foreground inside the mask, remains protected. Follower movement is allowed only within the frozen envelope.
policy.line_end_spaces: Existing trailing space glyphs may remain at a line edge; meaningful internal spaces are retained.
